messages.subject: Suppress warning message
parts:
When using 

missing="ML"

or

mimic="Mplus"

 lavaan throughs a warning for cases that are ignored, e.g:

lavaan WARNING: some cases are empty and will be ignored:
  57 120 327 406 609 692 1000 1124 1292 1299 1301 1302 1467 1471 1632 1953 1957 1967 2083 2452 2692 3067 3284 3488 4855 5852 5977 5995 5997 6047 6240 6334 6368 6440 6464 6546 6574 6644 6651 6785 6805 6934 6958 7030 7080 7111 8859 9188 10093 10186 10443 10503 10558 10602 10615 10650 10687 10689 10698 10699 10700 10741 10757 10826 10828 10830 10874 10889 11378 11395 11525 11531 11533 11534 11536 11537 11538 11583 11606 12021 12077 12169 12172 12177 12300 12605 12612 12629 12631 12636 12640 12751 12773 12794 12800 12803 12842 12852 12856 12857 12881 12898 12905 12906 12944 12946 12986 13039 13058 13060 13514 13691 14022 14660 14662 14953 14956 16357 16650 17049 18418 19781 19806 19835 20117 20674 20680 20691 20781 20957 21012 21039 21059 21061 21144 21186 21304 21425 21508 21509 21621 21814 21874 22031 22100 22195 22390 22789 22860 23109 23327 23515 23524 23529 23547 23554 23824 23825 24407 24440 24451 24516 24517 24596 24757 24903 [... truncated]

 Is there any way to suppress this specific warning message? Some cases will not be included when running FIML, but for me it is unnecessary to have a lengthy warning message on that. (Reported sample size used in the analysis is sufficient) .

Thanks for great software!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Suppress warning message
parts: Is there any way to suppress this specific warning message?

See the ?lavOptions help page about the "warn=" argument suppressing "possibly harmless warnings"

HolzingerSwineford1939[1, ] <- NA
HS.model <- ' visual  =~ x1 + x2 + x3
              textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
              speed   =~ x7 + x8 + x9 '
fit <- cfa(HS.model, data=HolzingerSwineford1939, missing = "fiml")
## suppress warning
fit <- cfa(HS.model, data=HolzingerSwineford1939, missing = "fiml", warn = FALSE)

Or you could also save a copy of your data with those completely empty cases (with respect to this analysis) removed. 

Terrence D. Jorgensen
